description: Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms - Order declaring provisions of the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (No. 25/2002)
reasoning: This gazette content is an order under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, No. 25 of 2002, declaring the application of the Act's provisions to specific countries based on international conventions and Commonwealth membership. It involves legal/regulatory matters by creating a statutory instrument that modifies the application of existing legislation, which falls squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
